description: Request and response signatures (wire 7.1) and the push webhook (wire 8.2). Request fields are the exact header texts, empty when absent; the timestamp is RFC 3339 UTC to the second. Response signatures cover u64(status), BLAKE3 of the decoded Switch-Signature (or of the empty string), the exact Switch-Server-Time text and BLAKE3(body).
